mission.title: Computer Crackdown
mission.description: Steal an informational dossier on an Exile for Zion.

phase.briefing:
The work that our Hacker completed inside the Machine Network has uncovered some interesting data. It appears that the Machines have known about the Exiles' strikes against our recruitment efforts ever since the truce was put in place. One piece of information leads us to a database that holds files on both active programs that are in the Matrix, and those that were in the Matrix, such as Exiles.
If you can access the computer at this location, it should lead us to those who are planning the attacks on our recruitment efforts.

enter.say: Tyndall has tracked the computer to this location. We don't have its exact position, but we know it's in this building.

objective.text: Find the room with the computer
Get the data disk from the computer

phase.briefing: Once the disk is with Alcor, we'll wrap this one up.

enter.say: I'm only seeing Alcor's signal, so this should be a quick in-and-out run.

objective.text: Give the data disk to Alcor
